tool.name: ask_user
tool.when:
Use ask_user when: 1. A decision needs the user's confirmation. 2. The user's plan is vague and needs clarification. 3. It is unclear whether or how the current plot should continue.
Being brave enough to ask questions is a good habit.
tool.desc: Prefer asking over assuming. Ask whenever uncertainty could change the outcome; do not proceed on unclear choices.
